reasons: no shader-throughput-bound pass: the cull dispatch runs ~41 000 ALU operations in 5.76 us, about 0.03 % of this GPU's arithmetic peak - it is dispatch-latency bound, so no change to the shader can move it
the draw region is 1024 indirect draws of a single triangle each: command-processor bound, not shader bound

the workload is not frame-deterministic - the back-buffer capture differs on every run (60a068f9, 843fca9c, bbb2396e), because the triangles are animated from wall-clock time - so the correctness oracle cannot be established without modifying the workload

measured.note: a transformation would have to be worth more than 8 % of the draw region to be detectable at all
